Resolves #21155

The shared test classifier treats `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` as a contributor-workflow helper. The four paths in the [observed run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/43908105577/job/133442331687) now select the unit suite and skip the fourteen Engine browser shards. The next unknown utility, an Engine runtime edit, or an e2e change still selects the browser tier.

Evidence: L2 (the committed workflow step executed with the real PR's four changed paths, mixed-path controls and two temporary source mutations) → L2 required (classifier outputs and a failing dependency tripwire).

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered in `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs`, “a contributor claim change runs units”. The prior classifier failed on `run_e2e`. The same test checks the explanation in the path report. |
| AC-2 | The mixed-file controls add a grid module, an e2e spec and an unknown utility separately. Each selects both units and e2e. The diff changes only the e2e path predicate and its tests. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered in the same spec, “a new reader of the claim or standing helper”. It inspects code, package scripts and the e2e runner for an added reader. Portal title data can mention a module. The standing module is the existing indirect reader. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

Temporary utility imports of either helper failed the dependency tripwire. A Portal JSON title containing `claimResponse.mjs` failed on the first head and passed after review. A `package.json` script invoking `contributorStanding.mjs` still failed and named the package file. With the probes removed, the classifier, e2e selection and claim-response suites passed all 136 tests.

## Post-Merge Validation

The next contributor-workflow-only edit can confirm the hosted skip and the successful required `e2e-engine` aggregate. This classifier edit itself should exercise the browser suite.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: The tripwire treats every `*.json` hit as a reader. A JSON file cannot import a module; the one JSON file that can launch a helper is `package.json`, through a script entry. The glob also reaches `apps/portal/resources/data/{tickets,pulls,discussions}/`. Those trees hold issue and PR titles, and `buildScripts/docs/index/{tickets,pulls,discussions}.mjs` write them; the ticket and pull generators read archived items as well as active ones. Closed #19971's title names `claimResponse.mjs`. Today no title there matches, and no data sync has written those trees on `dev` since 2026-08-26. But the next refresh turns the required `unit` context red on every PR, and the red points at a data file. RA-1.
- **Not required:** `contributorStanding.mjs` has the same reachability: its readers are `claim-responder.yml` and `merge-comment.yml`. It still admits the browser tier, and it changed 5 times on `dev` since 09-01. The tripwire already guards it, so a second exact entry costs one line if standing-only edits should skip too. Your call: the ticket scoped the four-file case.
